note: NECO Financial Accounting round 5 (R48 top-up): profit-sharing ratio; contingent liability; proforma invoice; increase in provision calc; vertical format; withholding tax; credit balance in sales ledger; free samples; carriage on a new machine; invoice details; sacrificing ratio; income and expenditure account of a club; obsolete stock; payslip; shares at a discount; accounting cycle; dissolution expenses; debit side; 'To' and 'By'; trial balance not conclusive; debtors net of provision; net profit to capital; market value of goods transferred; import duty; bank credit advice. Scanned against the whole Accounting pool (JAMB, WAEC and NECO stems).
